The offline registry is deliberately static. Adding an adapter, config, cut, scenario family, probe, port, or executable path requires a reviewed code change rather than request-time registration.

The v2 evaluation profile is structured and deterministic but qualitative. Its reasons, witnesses, false-closure detections, and maturity gates preserve review discipline; they do not replace owner judgment, validate live player balance, or convert correlated D2A sweeps into independent evidence.

The repaired movement-support cut passes only for two supplied states and one declared move command at seed 3237998097. It is not proof of a unique, minimal, all-command, all-seed, or globally support-complete carrier.

Protected-equivalent and invariant-region rows can classify supplied decoder/membership evidence, but this gate provides no domain-specific decoder proof or invariant-region predicate. Unprovided evidence remains not_assessed rather than inferred.

Strict schemas can validate declared structure, scope, lineage, and catalog membership but cannot prove that a deterministic-continuation, preservation, maturity, or authority claim is semantically true; later bounded witnesses and owner decisions remain mandatory.
The canonical format is the versioned local WP-015D2B contract, not a CRPM schema, ontology, graph-safe exchange standard, or claim of independent empirical evidence.

Authority-adapter parity is a read-only authorityProvenance relationship, not ProductAuthority. Current executable result/evaluation schemas cannot emit owner-reviewed, versioned-ruleset-approved, or production-active authority.
